title: NightWatch Error Code Registry
description: Unified error code registry, namespaced per logical component (§5.10 C01–C14). Semantics source: NightWatch Architecture v1.4 §5.4 error model, §5.10, §22.5.4. Each code carries: semantics, HTTP mapping (reference for C02), default retryable. Required semantic categories (WorkRequest §5.4): idempotency-conflict, timeout, cancellation, lock-expired, policy-denied, credential-missing, validation-failed, unauthorized.

CTL_.component: C02 Control API and Agent Host Adapter

REG_.component: C05 Contract Intake and API Registry

EVD_.component: C11 Evidence Pipeline and Immutable Run Store

AUD_.component: C14 Audit, Checkpoint and Catalog Index

CTL_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.semantics: Idempotency conflict: a command with the same idempotency key was already accepted with a different payload.

CTL_VALIDATION_FAILED.semantics: Request payload failed schema or contract validation.

CTL_UNAUTHORIZED.semantics: Caller is not authorized for the requested operation (missing/invalid/expired capability or session token).

CTL_COMMAND_TIMEOUT.semantics: Command deadline exceeded before the operation started or completed.

CTL_COMMAND_CANCELLED.semantics: Command or operation was cancelled before completion (user- or system-initiated).

CTL_LOCK_EXPIRED.semantics: Requested lock has expired; expired locks are rejected by default, never auto-extended.

REG_SPEC_INVALID.semantics: Imported spec failed parse/normalize/validate; the last valid registry version is NOT overwritten.

REG_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.semantics: Contract source (file/git/http/D0) could not be fetched.

REG_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH.semantics: Fetched contract checksum does not match the pinned checksum.

LIB_CASE_INVALID.semantics: Test case violates the case model constraints (e.g. requires reading the database as a mandatory assertion).

LIB_CASE_NOT_FOUND.semantics: Referenced test case does not exist in the library.

LIB_DUPLICATE_CASE.semantics: A case with the same identity already exists in the library.

CMP_COMPILE_FAILED.semantics: Deterministic compilation of validated cases into executor assets failed.

CMP_STATIC_CHECK_FAILED.semantics: Compiled asset failed static validation before execution.

POL_DENIED.semantics: Policy decision denied the action (environment class, destructive/load limit, request budget, publish gate).

POL_APPROVAL_EXPIRED.semantics: Required approval record has expired; expired approvals are rejected by default, never auto-extended.

POL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.semantics: Request budget for the scope has been exhausted.

CRED_MISSING.semantics: Referenced credential is not configured in the provider; only the reference name is ever reported, never a value.

CRED_LEASE_EXPIRED.semantics: Credential injection lease has expired; expired leases are rejected by default, never auto-extended.

EXE_TIMEOUT.semantics: Execution exceeded its timeout budget; partial results are preserved as an independent outcome.

EXE_CANCELLED.semantics: Execution was cancelled: new steps stopped first, then workers terminated, then bounded cleanup executed.

EXE_TOOL_VERSION_MISMATCH.semantics: Pinned executor/tool version does not match the version requested or found.

EXE_WORKER_FAILED.semantics: Executor worker failed abnormally (non-zero exit, crash, signal).

FIX_SETUP_FAILED.semantics: Fixture setup through public APIs failed; resource ledger records partial state.

FIX_CLEANUP_FAILED.semantics: Fixture cleanup failed or timed out; residual resources are recorded as an independent result.

FIX_RESOURCE_LOCKED.semantics: Shared resource is held by another owner under an explicit lock.

EVD_NOT_SEALED.semantics: Run bundle is not sealed yet; downstream consumers may only reference sealed evidence.

EVD_SECRET_DETECTED.semantics: Secret scan detected credential-shaped material in evidence; publish is blocked.

EVD_MANIFEST_INVALID.semantics: Run manifest failed integrity or completeness validation.

FND_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.semantics: Evidence is insufficient to classify or publish; the observation stays local instead of becoming an issue.

FND_CLASSIFICATION_INVALID.semantics: Proposed finding classification is not legal for the collected evidence.

ISS_GATE_FAILED.semantics: Issue publish gate rejected the draft (evidence completeness, secret scan, fingerprint dedup, minimal reproduction, environment scope, or reviewer gate).

ISS_DUPLICATE.semantics: Fingerprint matches an existing issue; new reproduction info must be appended instead of creating a new issue.

ISS_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.semantics: Issue publish was already executed with the same idempotency key and a different payload.

AUD_CHECKPOINT_INVALID.semantics: Checkpoint is corrupt or fails validation; session recovery refuses to resume from it.

AUD_REPLAY_MISMATCH.semantics: Audit idempotency replay detected a mismatched record for the same key.
